entities.name: Aerona
entities.description: Region of the Domains of Dominaria.

entities.name: Coraleon
entities.description: City in North Aerona holding the Festival of Sorrow.

entities.name: Boxx
entities.description: A wizard who is a box or uses one as a stand-in body.

entities.name: Eorra
entities.description: Elvish woman, the only person to beat Gormank in combat, resurrected by Boxx.

entities.name: Dolores
entities.description: Lady of Sorrow who forbade magic during the festival.

entities.name: Scavenging Ghoul
entities.description: Boxx's ghoul who led Gormank to him.

events.summary: Gormank travels to Coraleon to have Boxx resurrect Eorra, despite Dolores forbidding magic during the Festival of Sorrow.
events.quote: Unfortunately, Coraleon's Festival of Sorrow was going on, and the Lady of Sorrow, Dolores forbade the use of magic

events.summary: Gormank bribes Boxx with an amulet and they go to the cemetery to find Eorra's grave.
events.quote: Gormank bribed the wizard's box with a magical amulet

events.summary: Boxx resurrects Eorra, who is severely weakened.
events.quote: Boxx went ahead and resurrected Eorra, but she was severely weakened

events.summary: Gormank realizes he can never restore his honor.
events.quote: Gormank, who had boasted he never felt sorrow, realized he could never restore his honor.

events.summary: Dolores reveals she allowed the ritual because she knew the result would crush him; Gormank joins the Festival of Sorrow.
events.quote: she had seen into Gormank's soul and knew that the result would crush him

relations.note: Only person to best him in combat.
relations.quote: Eorra was the only person to ever best Gormank in combat
The ogre, the ghoul, and the box traveled to the cemetery
